items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron were commanded to speak to the children of Israel about which beasts they shall eat

items.quote: These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
items.claim: The children of Israel shall eat certain designated beasts
